description: Synthetic PaddleOCR-VL layoutParsingResults payload (3 pages, 2x pixel coordinates) filling the gaps of the other Paddle fixtures: labels aside_text, header_image, footer_image, inline_formula (standalone block and layout_det boxes inside text blocks), reference (vs reference_content); plus geometry edge cases: overlapping blocks, a 12x10 px block, a stuffed two-column block with an empty peer (repaired on page 2, detection-only on the landscape page 3), a landscape page and a furniture-only page. Page 1 = empty body, page 2 = two-column paper page (enable_body_repair=true), page 3 = landscape. Every label and bbox is hand-designed by gen_raw.py.

validator_rejects.note: raised inside adapt_payload_to_document_v1 (build_validation_report), not only by validate_document_payload; raw.json differs only in that footer's x1 (1224 instead of 1226)

tricky_points: Inline formula pairing is all-or-nothing per block: boxes are assigned only when the number of $..$ segments equals the number of inline_formula layout_det boxes lying entirely inside the block bbox (page 2 block 4: 2/2 assigned; block 5: 2 segments vs 3 boxes -> none assigned).

A standalone inline_formula block also exists as a layout_det box with the same coordinates, so it is its own candidate and gets a provider_layout bbox; any other text block enclosing that rectangle would count it as an extra candidate (the fixture keeps it outside every other block on purpose).

inline_formula and reference have no legacy projection: both become content.kind=unknown with translate=false (provider_non_text:unknown); reference is a region/container, reference_content is the entry label that gets reference_entry.
header_image/footer_image normalize like image: image/image_body, no header/footer layout role, so the header/footer placement is only recoverable from provenance.raw_label and layout_det_label.
footer_image content has no src=; the asset is only reachable through the _box_x0_y0_x1_y1 filename in markdown.images (bbox tolerance 2 px exact match).

Body repair only runs when pruned.model_settings.enable_body_repair is true; page 2 sets it, page 3 does not, so the same stuffed defect shows both outcomes. Equal-length halves put the split exactly on the column boundary.
Column signals are recomputed after repair, so a repaired pair loses its text_missing_but_bbox_present/peer_block_absorbed_text flags and only keeps body_repair_* metadata.
An empty peer block that is not repaired still gets translate=true (kind text/body, 0 segments, empty text).
aside_text: the adapter metadata says layout_role=unknown while the final block.layout_role is paragraph (contract_v1 fills it from block type).
Coordinates are px at 2x but the adapter stores them unscaled in a page with unit 'pt' and width/height in px (1224 x 1584); the 2 px overflow case is therefore judged against the px page size.
Aside text and header_image/footer_image labels have block_order=null in the raw payload (like header/footer/number).
